# DSH Sidebar History

> An independent, MIT-licensed DeepSeek Harness sidebar plugin. History cards show per-session TODO progress and the latest committed assistant reply.

## Product facts

- Package version: 0.2.3. Verified DSH target: 0.2.2-rc.1, upstream commit fcc0ad462172522aaf5c93a7b2e01f6b9f0b0159.
- Requires Node.js >=24.9.0 and a DSH Web profile. Other declared compatible versions are not independently verified.
- TODO status comes from native todo/write events. A new turn clears the previous turn's tasks.
- Reply previews use committed assistant/message text. Earlier reply identifies a previous turn; no task list this turn does not mean earlier work is done. Empty/tool-only messages preserve useful text. Interrupted output, reasoning, and tool results are excluded.
- Read-only Markdown previews use DSH’s GFM grammar. Bold, emphasis, strikethrough, and code are formatted; lists/tables become compact text, links show labels, and images show alt text. No navigation, remote image loading, or raw HTML interpretation.
- Workspaces & archives opens native session actions; History cards restores search, scroll, and focused session. Failed remote search keeps local matches, offers retry, and marks results incomplete. Content-search result limits are explicit. Remote-only matches survive navigation.
- Bounded sidebarHistory projection v2 replays old durable logs without activating historical Agents. Accessible card descriptions expose task counts/states, useful reply text, and turn context.
- Sidebar UI languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Spanish. Traditional Chinese also provides a native-host language pack covering 17 namespaces and 1829 keys, with fallback for namespaces outside that pack. README languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Spanish.
- Each README maps to its own language-specific original recording using the official DeepSeek API. Version 0.2.3 has fresh, verified language-specific API captures, native lifecycle checks and real Chromium video playback. The Chinese website uses Simplified Chinese media; the English website uses English media. It contains no scripted model replies or seeded TODO events.
- Repository metrics do not measure active installations, Google ranking, or user retention.
